key_insight: Operate in the pre-RoPE vector space—where Q/K vectors concentrate around a fixed non-zero center—and use a trigonometric compression of KV representations (TriAttention) to produce rotation-stable, highly compact KV caches for long-context reasoning.
problem_solved: KV cache memory bottlenecks and unstable top-key selection in extended LLM reasoning caused by RoPE-induced query rotation and poor importance estimation.
method: Analyze pre-RoPE Q/K statistics and identify a stable non-zero center that makes representations rotation-invariant compared to post-RoPE queries.
Apply trigonometric-based compression to encode KV pairs (angles/magnitudes or sin/cos components) so keys can be grouped and ranked reliably despite positional rotation.
Integrate compressed KV storage with attention retrieval to keep top keys accurately while drastically reducing memory footprint for long sequences.
impact: Enables more memory-efficient, stable long-range inference for LLMs, improving throughput and practicability of extended reasoning on existing hardware without sacrificing key-selection fidelity.

paper_title: TriAttention: Efficient Long Reasoning with Trigonometric KV Compression
paper_authors: Weian Mao, Xi Lin, Wei Huang, Yuxin Xie, Tianfu Fu
